title: Ask HN: Is charging for software a thing of the past?
excerpt: Fully on the decompile hype train here - I'm wondering how much longer the traditional software market has? I've recently been moving my app ideas over to an open source approach. Do games differ to tools, which are much more defined tasks for AI to replicate?
content_html:
Ask HN: Is charging for software a thing of the past?
2 points by terranivium 12 hours ago | hide | past | favorite | 1 comment

Fully on the decompile hype train here - I'm wondering how much longer the traditional software market has? I've recently been moving my app ideas over to an open source approach. Do games differ to tools, which are much more defined tasks for AI to replicate?
